title: Sinnoh jogável — piloto Twinleaf a Sandgem
phase_count_policy: J01-J05 represent executable engineering code and CI checks only. J05 fixes starter event-to-engine binding and adds compensating scoped party+flags transactions, Barry all-3 PBS validation, Dex-save rollback; existing event handlers preserved. No native events, maps or saves loaded; no Game.exe/JoiPlay, 5 maps physically absent. L/documental reports never count.

stages.title: Verificar instalação real e fonte de mapas
stages.completion_requires: Preflight runnable, fail-closed checks and regression CI pass; local real baseline still pending

stages.title: Reservar MapIDs e vincular os 9 mapas do piloto
stages.completion_requires: J02 executable 9-map source-to-destination validator and audited 4/9 historical terrain reference catalog complete; requires five new real maps, local game/Data, reservations R07 and rights R08 before any native binding or installation.

stages.title: Converter terrenos e tilesets para cópia isolada
stages.completion_requires: Executable geometry-only converter and private SHA-approved dry-run/stage/verify/rollback implemented with synthetic QA tests; NO real four-map stage created here and five real maps missing. Requires local authorized source and rights review; not native playable.

stages.title: Compilar 16 portais, 5 NPCs e 3 Poké Bolas
stages.completion_requires: J04 code compiles 16 warps, 5 Blue handler calls and 3 unique starter-ball events with verified 9-map stage/coordinate/passability/sprite SHA gates. Real maps 5/9 absent and handlers unbound until J05; no native J04 event compiled on real assets.

stages.title: Integrar Barry, regras de batalha e save Sinnoh
stages.completion_requires: J05 code: five existing BlueSinnohPilot handlers exercised, physical starter calls corrected, single starter save flag/party compensation, all three Barry trainer versions verified, false/nil battle and dex setter failure fail-closed, isolation and save/reload Ruby fixtures. Native 9 maps+sprites/PBS compilation & physical QA pending; no installed/save migrated.

stages.title: Preparar instalador/launcher Windows do piloto
stages.completion_requires: User can launch isolated Windows pilot without modifying main install or saves

stages.title: Validar Windows, saves e regressões multirregionais
stages.completion_requires: Windows native QA and regional/save regressions reviewed

stages.title: Preparar, testar e distribuir piloto Android/JoiPlay
stages.completion_requires: Android/JoiPlay QA on isolated test package and safe incremental release

blockers: J05 valida código de cinco handlers e três iniciais, mas os métodos não foram executados por Game.exe; apenas fixtures Ruby sintéticas.
J04 exige nove mapas; cinco ainda não têm geometria real: quarto, casa 1F, casa Barry, Lago Verity e laboratório Rowan.
Faltam hashes MapInfos reais e aprovação R07, sprites de NPCs, autorização/uso R08, passabilidade e 16 destinos físicos de portais.
Três versões PBS Barry e regras Normal/Master necessitam compilação/teste no runtime autorizado; o probe offline não equivale a batalha nativa.
Isolamento de save do SinnohQAStart tem contratos em código, sem execução de Save/Load no Game.exe; 0/44 QA G12, 0/9 mapas, 0/24 eventos instalados.
